portedFromTheOracle.summary: src/renderer.js drawPostDive(): dive time; maxDepth; the average depth avgDepthAccum / avgDepthSamples (0 without samples); per open-circuit tank totalGas - gasRemaining of totalGas; on a rebreather (BUG-24) the oxygen and diluent used, (start - current pressure) x cylinder volume, with the bar left, the scrubber time used, scrubberTotal - scrubberRemaining, and the bailout; the safety-stop warning when safetyStopNeeded && !safetyStopComplete; the grade from gradeDive().
portedFromTheOracle.violations: src/renderer.js drawDiveProfileChart() marks every diveEvents entry: fastAscent with its peak rate, ceilingViolation with how far above the ceiling, safetyStopSkipped at the surface. The summary lists the dive log's entries in that order.

parity: At every checkpoint of all twelve recorded dives (52), legacy's own expressions applied to the recorded globals against the summary of the adapter's state there: dive time, maxDepth.toFixed(1), the average depth's toFixed(1), the violation list's kinds, times and values, the safety-stop warning, and the gas lines to the whole litre, bar and minute legacy draws (open circuit per tank; the rebreather's oxygen, diluent, scrubber and bailout). Named acceptance traces: air-18m-30min/surfaced (legacy's post-dive screen, the stop skipped, grade scores equal), buoyancy-vent-inflate-12m/coasting-30s (a fast ascent) and trimix-dcs-above-stop/above-stop-30s (a broken ceiling). The model's own log against legacy's diveEvents is covered by tests/parity/dive-log.test.ts and dive-end.test.ts.
